tool_description:
An API that provides information about all mobile brands and their devices would be a comprehensive source of data for developers seeking to build applications or services related to mobile devices. Such an API could include details on all the mobile brands currently on the market, as well as information about each brand's individual devices, such as model names, technical specifications, and images. The
